paragraphs: Rabbah bar Shilat, Gittin 39b, according to the reading of the Bach.
Rav Shmuel bar Shilat: Shabbat 153a. Shilat’s grandson Rav Yehudah: Berakhot 47a.
And in the Shitah Mekubetzet, Ketubot 62a, it is cited in the name of Rabbenu Hai Gaon that Shilat is a feminine name: the sister of Rabbi Chiyya.

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Berakhot 47a explicitly names Rav Yehudah as Rav Shmuel bar Shilat’s son, consistent with the notice calling him Shilat’s grandson. The explanation that Shilat is a woman, Rabbi Chiya’s sister, is attributed to Rabbenu Hai Gaon in Shitah Mekubetzet.
